title: Proposal: Edgeware Agency Funding
body:
## **Agency Proposal Summary **
## **Updated: May 27 2020**

**Why does this document exist? **
This proposal and its process has been in development for a long time, with all working done in public. With the main documents in long form and an accompanying spreadsheet, we’ve received feedback that we should make the proposal more accessible and legible. 

**Some of the critiques we take seriously and want to answer to: **
- Lack of clarity around overall strategy and plan.
- Lack of clarity around deliverables.
- Lack of clarity around past and proposed compensation structures.


# **Important Points**

**Resources**
- Original [Proposal Text](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sb4taXPYl1ZubAowm8nlFO4TjYU9AEH0EhOVAOXOStQ/edit#heading=h.qrwa3a30bv8m)
- Current [Proposed Deliverables](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1MFX8mCvkuXHXmrEaG19wbhZYyqbiVrRcEW2WfuzShSQ/edit#gid=0)
- Agency [Finances](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1NaeqLwO-GbQvQjIIozI0hNVULgtPZ2hkakGqjsKe7RY/edit#gid=0)
- Agency [Staffing Cost Estimates](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1uj47u8RbhcoMK_mzU40ZbPVVcxjwQ5PU4PIuHY-4kRI)


**What’s the reason to have the Agency?**
Edgeware, unlike most chains, did not have a centralized launch. As a result, it also does not have a traditional foundation empowered to sign contracts, pay traditional companies, or conduct basic business activities. Commonwealth Labs, who helped coordinate the launch of Edgeware and has thus far solely supported the development of the chain and several business development functions, is now ready to focus on specific applications on Edgeware.

The mission was always for Edgeware to fund and sustain itself. As a result, a set of longtime and some new community members have figured out how to work together to empower and enforce standards that center community-ownership in Edgeware and to drive core community engagement and adoption.
